name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is not what the task says. The task bans dropping the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once; `key_lost` is only an event when the key is dropped while the door is closed. Because the proposition already includes that closed-door condition, the ban is hard Absence(key_lost), not Precedence(door_open, key_lost). Keep the hard Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Absence(key_lost) is too strict. The task allows dropping the key after the door has been opened once, but key_lost only records drops while the door is closed. Replace it with hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost), which bans key_lost only until the door has opened. Keep hard Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Absence(key_lost) treats every key_lost event as forbidden, even after the door has been opened. The task only forbids dropping the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once; remove this Absence and use a rule that restricts key_lost only before the door has opened. Keep the hard Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Absence(key_lost) bans key_lost for the entire episode, but the task only forbids dropping the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Replace it with hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost), which ends the ban after the door first opens. Keep hard Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Hard Absence(key_lost) forbids key_lost for the entire episode, but the task only forbids dropping the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once. Replace it with hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost), which permits key_lost after the door has opened. Keep hard Existence(at_goal).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) forbids dropping the key while the door is closed until it has been opened, and Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal.
